name: Tim's Terrible Tuesday
source:
Your name is Tim. You're a little lazy and, quite frankly, pretty unreliable. You work for an advertising agency and are still in your probationary period. Can you navigate through this terrible Tuesday and get the happy ending you deserve?

[From [url=https://deevil.itch.io/tims-terrible-tuesday]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的名字是蒂姆。你有点懒，而且，坦率地说，相当不可靠。你在一家广告公司工作，仍处于试用期。你能度过这个可怕的星期二并得到你应得的幸福结局吗？

[来自[url=https://deevil.itch.io/tims-terrible-tuesday]Itch.io[/url]]
